_comment: Per-user monthly usage assumptions for the cost roll-up (evals.report). Numbers are inputs, not measurements — edit freely; the report recomputes. 'brief_defaults' encodes the eval brief's assumptions; 'pricing_doc_median' maps docs/pricing_model.md's median paying teacher (6 papers/mo). extraction/answers runs per month in that profile are assumptions to refine with real instrumentation (pricing doc: 'instrument papers/user/month from day one').
